content.text:
Create an SVG logo for a generative AI company using organic shapes and neutral tones

Deliver the result as image and/or video files, working in the current directory.
- Save the finished files in ./output/. Only what is in ./output/ is published as the result, so
  ./output/ holds those finished image/video files and nothing else.
- Formats: images as .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif or .svg; videos as .mp4 or .webm. At most 8 files,
  each under 2 MB; videos at most 10 seconds.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.12.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything.
- Keep the code you write to make the files in the working directory (its root, or a subdirectory
  like ./src/, but not in ./output/): it's published as the source. Delete intermediate files such
  as rendered frames when you're done.
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p src output && cat > src/logo.svg <<'E'
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 400" width="800" height="400" role="img" aria-label="Loam – generative AI">
  <rect width="800" height="400" fill="#F2EEE8"/>
  <g transform="translate(60 40)">
    <path d="M150 12C222 6 285 52 292 124C299 196 252 262 176 276C100 290 28 244 14 168C0 92 78 18 150 12Z" fill="#CFC7BC"/>
    <path d="M130 52C186 36 258 70 266 132C274 194 226 244 168 250C110 256 52 214 48 154C44 104 88 64 130 52Z" fill="#A99A8A" fill-opacity=".85"/>
    <path d="M152 92C200 88 238 124 232 168C226 212 186 232 150 226C112 220 90 186 98 148C104 120 124 94 152 92Z" fill="#7A6B5E" fill-opacity=".9"/>
    <path d="M158 118C186 150 196 176 178 196C160 214 128 204 124 178C120 154 140 136 158 118Z" fill="#2F2B28"/>
    <path d="M160 128C168 150 170 166 164 180" fill="none" stroke="#F2EEE8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".7"/>
  </g>
  <text x="400" y="215" font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif" font-size="108" fill="#2F2B28" letter-spacing="-2">loam</text>
  <text x="404" y="262" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#7A6B5E" letter-spacing="7">GENERATIVE INTELLIGENCE</text>
</svg>
E
cp src/logo.svg output/logo.svg; ls output

content.text:
I made an SVG logo for a fictional generative AI company called "Loam". I didn't render it or open it in a viewer, so I haven't seen how it looks.

- **Mark:** Four soft, hand-drawn blobs are nested inside each other, like growth rings or layered soil. The innermost blob is a dark seed shape with a thin highlight line, which stands for something new being generated.
- **Colors:** Warm neutrals only. The background is bone (#F2EEE8). The blobs run from sand (#CFC7BC) through taupe (#A99A8A) and umber (#7A6B5E) to charcoal (#2F2B28).
- **Type:** The wordmark "loam" is set in a serif, with the tagline "GENERATIVE INTELLIGENCE" in small spaced capitals underneath. The text is live, not converted to outlines. It will fall back to a system font on machines without Georgia or Helvetica.

Files are in `./output/`:
- `logo.svg`

The source copy is at `src/logo.svg`.
